items.title: Royal Caribbean Group Reports Strong Q2 2026 Results as Legend of the Seas Debuts and Short Cruise Demand Surges
items.summary: Royal Caribbean Group reported strong Q2 2026 results, exceeding Wall Street expectations with $4.83 billion in revenue and adjusted EPS of $4.21, leading to an upward revision of their full-year guidance. The debut of "Legend of the Seas" significantly boosted capacity, and the company observed a growing demand for shorter cruises, particularly among new and younger travelers. Despite geopolitical impacts on some bookings, overall demand and pricing remain at record levels, with the company returning over $600 million to investors.

items.title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber (NASDAQ: GT) swings to H1 2026 loss on charges
items.summary: Goodyear Tire & Rubber (NASDAQ: GT) reported a net loss for both Q2 2026 ($204 million) and H1 2026 ($453 million), a significant decline from profits in the prior year, attributed to restructuring charges, lower sales, and decreased segment operating income. The company's financial performance was negatively impacted by reduced tire unit shipments, inflationary cost pressures, and increased conversion costs, despite benefits from its Goodyear Forward transformation plan and lower raw material costs. Goodyear also announced the planned permanent closure of its Fayetteville, North Carolina tire manufacturing facility by the end of 2027 as part of ongoing rationalization efforts, incurring substantial pre-tax charges.

items.title: Earnings call transcript: Cognex posts record Q2 2026 revenue, shares slip
items.summary: Cognex Corp. reported record second-quarter 2026 revenue of $291 million, up 17% year-over-year, and adjusted earnings per share of $0.45, surpassing analyst estimates. Despite strong financial performance and an optimistic full-year outlook, the company's stock experienced a slight slip in after-hours trading, likely due to a narrow miss on revenue forecasts and potential future memory cost pressures. Management emphasized continued strategic execution, margin expansion, and diversification into new high-growth markets like the data center supply chain.

items.title: CoStar, Tourism Economics upgrade U.S. hotel growth forecast
items.summary: CoStar and Tourism Economics have upgraded their U.S. hotel growth forecast for 2026-27, increasing projected gains for RevPAR and ADR. This improvement is attributed to strong leisure and business travel, including events like the World Cup, and resilient consumer spending driven by stable labor markets and easing inflation. While expenses are expected to rise, GOPPAR is still forecast to increase by 4% this year and 1% next year.

items.title: International Business Machines Corp Stock (IBM) Opened Down by 3.17% on Aug 6: A Full Analysis
items.summary: IBM's stock opened down by 3.17% due to investor concerns over the slow pace of enterprise AI adoption and a potential prolonged recovery in its consulting business. Macroeconomic headwinds, such as persistent inflation and restrictive monetary policy, are further impacting the company's valuation and client IT spending. Despite solid fundamentals, IBM faces competitive pressures in generative AI and operational risks during its transition from legacy services to software models.

items.title: Earnings call transcript: Himax tops Q2 2026 forecasts as margins widen
items.summary: Himax Technologies reported strong Q2 2026 results, exceeding Wall Street expectations with diluted earnings of $0.114 per ADS and revenue of $227.4 million, driven by robust automotive chip sales and improved gross margins. The company provided optimistic guidance for Q3, projecting continued revenue growth and margin expansion, particularly highlighting the significant long-term potential in its automotive display IC and emerging non-driver businesses like CPO and smart glasses, despite ongoing supply chain challenges.

items.title: Disposable protective apparel sales rise 24.9% at Alpha Pro Tech
items.summary: Alpha Pro Tech (APT) reported a 12.0% increase in Q2 2026 net sales to $18.7 million, with disposable protective apparel sales rising 24.9% and building supply sales up 5.5%. Net income grew 46.8% to $1.8 million, or $0.18 per diluted share. The company maintains a strong financial position with $18.9 million in cash and no debt, but faces challenges in the housing market and uncertainty regarding future tariff refunds.

Despite its broad exposure, RSPD holds a Zacks ETF Rank of 4 (Sell), suggesting better alternatives exist for investors.

items.title: Fox Corporation Declares Semi-Annual Dividend on Class A and Class B Shares, Payable on September 23, 2026
items.summary: Fox Corporation has announced an increase in its semi-annual dividend to $0.29 per Class A and Class B share. The dividend will be payable on September 23, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 02, 2026. This declaration follows the company's fiscal fourth-quarter results, which reportedly topped street estimates.

items.title: Tennant Plunges 12.8% on EPS Beat
items.summary: Tennant Company shares dropped 12.8% after reporting Q2 2026 earnings, despite an EPS beat. The market's negative reaction suggests investors had higher expectations for the industrial machinery maker, possibly due to disappointing guidance or margin commentary. This significant decline indicates broad selling pressure and raises questions about future demand visibility and competitive positioning for Tennant.
